// 开地形的分区场景演练（seamlessdrill -terrain，scripts/test-seamless-demo.sh 的 ROOST_SEAMLESS_TERRAIN=1）：与
// drill.go 同一个程序（同一套登录、玩家 TCP、同步帧解码与 GM），换一套地形专用的步骤。地图与分区（脚本写的配置）：
//
//   - 地形包：4 × 2 块的平地（-write-flat-pack 写出：原始高度 1000 = 世界高度 0、没有水），256m × 128m；
//   - 分区：2 × 1 个 12800（两块）见方的格，格 (0,0) 归 sid 1001（A）、格 (1,0) 归 sid 1002（B），分界线 x = 12800；
//     游戏尺度的主视野（P5）：view_radius 6800、hysteresis 200、ghost_band 7000，越过分界线 200 才交接（x ≥ 13000）。
//     70m 的 Ghost 带比一块宽：A、B 的地形视图都装着整张图（邻格的块只读）；sid 1000、1004 只做 Base，不装块；
//   - 刷怪：格 A 里一只沿 X 往返的怪（y = 9000，600 单位 / 秒）；玩家进场点 (11800, 3000)，也在格 A。
//
// 玩家：pA 连 A（改 A 的块）、pB 与 pB2 连 B（改 B 的块；(a) 里 pB 有一笔跨格笔刷，P5）、pW 连只做 Base 的 sid 1004（跨格走的玩家，也是“别的进程上
// 的客户端”）。每一步打印 “STEP <名字> ok …”，失败以非零退出；evidence.json 记下各步的数字。
package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/binary"
	"errors"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"hash/fnv"
	"math"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"MMO_MODULE/db"
	terrain_chunk "MMO_MODULE/game/entities/terrain_chunk"
	"MMO_MODULE/protocol/msgid"
	"MMO_MODULE/protocol/pb"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/gameplay/terrain"
)

var (
	terrainMode   = flag.Bool("terrain", false, "run the editable-terrain drill instead of the partition drill")
	writeFlatPack = flag.String("write-flat-pack", "", "write the terrain drill's flat 4 x 2 chunk pack to this path and exit")
)

const (
	tBoundary = 12800           // 格 A / B 的分界线 x
	tHandoff  = tBoundary + 200 // 越过它才交接（hysteresis 200）
	tSpeed    = 600             // max_speed
	tFlatRaw  = 1000            // 平地的原始高度
	tPlayerY  = 3000            // 玩家走的线（进场点的 y）
	tMonsterY = 9000            // 怪走的线
	tStepRaw  = 50              // 高坎：原始值 + 50 = 5 米（DefaultWalkRules：1 米内超过 1 米、台阶超过 0.5 米都走不上去）
	// 业务码（internal/errors/terrain.go）：terrain_rate。
	codeTerrainRate = 100056
	// 跨格编辑（P5）每块的结论（TerrainChunkVersion.Outcome）：1 = 这次执行了。
	outcomeApplied = 1
)

// writeFlatTerrainPack 写演练用的地形包：4 × 2 块、每点原始高度 1000、没有水（WaterLevel 取最小值），BaseRevision 1。
func writeFlatTerrainPack(path string) error {
	meta := terrain.Meta{BaseRevision: 1, ChunksX: 4, ChunksY: 2, HeightBase: -10000, WaterLevel: math.MinInt32}
	return terrain.WritePackFile(path, meta, func(terrain.ChunkKey) (terrain.Chunk, error) {
		c := terrain.NewChunk()
		for i := range c.Heights {
			c.Heights[i] = tFlatRaw
		}
		return c, nil
	})
}

// ---- 客户端一侧的地形块 ----

// terrainHeld 是一个客户端收到的地形块（terrain 命名空间，生成的 ApplySyncTerrainChunkDao 应用全量与增量）与每块每个
// 版本第一次到达的时刻。由 client.mu 保护。
type terrainHeld struct {
	chunks map[int64]*db.SyncTerrainChunkDao
	seen   map[int64]map[int64]time.Time
}

// applyTerrain 应用一个地形块更新（持 c.mu，在 consume 里调用）。
func (c *client) applyTerrain(update entity.SubjectSyncUpdate, now time.Time) error {
	if c.terrain == nil {
		c.terrain = &terrainHeld{chunks: map[int64]*db.SyncTerrainChunkDao{}, seen: map[int64]map[int64]time.Time{}}
	}
	patch, err := db.UnmarshalSyncTerrainChunkDao(update.Payload.BytesCopy())
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	previous := c.terrain.chunks[update.SubjectID]
	if update.Full {
		previous = nil
	}
	next, err := db.ApplySyncTerrainChunkDao(patch, previous)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("apply terrain chunk %d: %w", update.SubjectID, err)
	}
	c.terrain.chunks[update.SubjectID] = next
	if next.Version != nil {
		versions := c.terrain.seen[update.SubjectID]
		if versions == nil {
			versions = map[int64]time.Time{}
			c.terrain.seen[update.SubjectID] = versions
		}
		if _, ok := versions[next.Version.Value]; !ok {
			versions[next.Version.Value] = now
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// forgetTerrain 是地形块被 remove（持 c.mu）。
func (c *client) forgetTerrain(subject int64) {
	if c.terrain != nil {
		delete(c.terrain.chunks, subject)
	}
}

// chunkID 是客户端持有的 key 那一块的 subject ID。按唯一号认（KeyOf）：本程序没有登记实体种类，BuildEntityID 解析
// 不出类别、拼不出完整 ID。没有这块时 ok 为 false。持 c.mu 调用。
func (c *client) chunkID(key terrain.ChunkKey) (int64, bool) {
	if c.terrain == nil {
		return 0, false
	}
	for id := range c.terrain.chunks {
		if terrain_chunk.KeyOf(id) == key {
			return id, true
		}
	}
	return 0, false
}

// chunk 是客户端持有的一块：版本与数据摘要（与 gm.terrain.probe 同一规则）；没有这块时 ok 为 false。
func (c *client) chunk(key terrain.ChunkKey) (version int64, digest string, ok bool) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	id, held := c.chunkID(key)
	if !held {
		return 0, "", false
	}
	got := c.terrain.chunks[id]
	if got == nil || got.Version == nil || got.Heights == nil || got.Materials == nil {
		return 0, "", false
	}
	materials := make([]byte, len(got.Materials.Value))
	for i, v := range got.Materials.Value {
		materials[i] = byte(v)
	}
	return got.Version.Value, chunkDigest(got.Heights.Value, materials), true
}

// terrainSummary 列出客户端持有的地形块与版本（诊断）。
func (c *client) terrainSummary() string {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	if c.terrain == nil {
		return "nothing"
	}
	var parts []string
	for id, chunk := range c.terrain.chunks {
		v := int64(-1)
		if chunk.Version != nil {
			v = chunk.Version.Value
		}
		heights, materials := -1, -1
		if chunk.Heights != nil {
			heights = len(chunk.Heights.Value)
		}
		if chunk.Materials != nil {
			materials = len(chunk.Materials.Value)
		}
		parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%v:v%d/h%d/m%d", terrain_chunk.KeyOf(id), v, heights, materials))
	}
	sort.Strings(parts)
	return "[" + strings.Join(parts, " ") + "]"
}

// chunkSeenAt 是客户端第一次收到这块这个版本的时刻。
func (c *client) chunkSeenAt(key terrain.ChunkKey, version int64) (time.Time, bool) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	id, held := c.chunkID(key)
	if !held {
		return time.Time{}, false
	}
	at, ok := c.terrain.seen[id][version]
	return at, ok
}

// chunkDigest：FNV-1a 64 依次过高度（小端 2 字节）与材质（1 字节），十六进制。与 demo 的 terrainChunkDigest 同一定义。
func chunkDigest(heights []uint16, materials []byte) string {
	h := fnv.New64a()
	buf := make([]byte, 0, 2*len(heights)+len(materials))
	for _, v := range heights {
		buf = binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint16(buf, v)
	}
	buf = append(buf, materials...)
	_, _ = h.Write(buf)
	return fmt.Sprintf("%016x", h.Sum64())
}

// ---- 服务端一侧：gm.terrain.probe ----

type chunkProbe struct {
	Owned, Loaded bool
	Version, Held int64
	Digest        string
}

func (p chunkProbe) String() string {
	if !p.Loaded {
		return fmt.Sprintf("{owned %v not loaded held %d}", p.Owned, p.Held)
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("{owned %v v%d held %d %s}", p.Owned, p.Version, p.Held, p.Digest)
}

var allChunks = func() []terrain.ChunkKey {
	var keys []terrain.ChunkKey
	for y := int32(0); y < 2; y++ {
		for x := int32(0); x < 4; x++ {
			keys = append(keys, terrain.ChunkKey{X: x, Y: y})
		}
	}
	return keys
}()

// probe 读 sid 进程地形视图里的块与点（点答世界高度；读不到时 heights 里没有它）。
func probe(ctx context.Context, sid int32, keys []terrain.ChunkKey, points ...[2]int64) (map[terrain.ChunkKey]chunkProbe, map[[2]int64]int64, error) {
	chunks := make([][2]int32, 0, len(keys))
	for _, k := range keys {
		chunks = append(chunks, [2]int32{k.X, k.Y})
	}
	data, err := gm(ctx, sid, "gm.terrain.probe", map[string]any{"chunks": chunks, "points": points})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	out := map[terrain.ChunkKey]chunkProbe{}
	rawChunks, _ := data["chunks"].([]any)
	for _, item := range rawChunks {
		m, _ := item.(map[string]any)
		key := terrain.ChunkKey{X: int32(asInt(m["x"])), Y: int32(asInt(m["y"]))}
		p := chunkProbe{Held: asInt(m["held"])}
		p.Owned, _ = m["owned"].(bool)
		p.Loaded, _ = m["loaded"].(bool)
		if p.Loaded {
			p.Version = asInt(m["version"])
			p.Digest, _ = m["digest"].(string)
		}
		out[key] = p
	}
	heights := map[[2]int64]int64{}
	rawPoints, _ := data["points"].([]any)
	for _, item := range rawPoints {
		m, _ := item.(map[string]any)
		if _, ok := m["height"]; ok {
			heights[[2]int64{asInt(m["x"]), asInt(m["y"])}] = asInt(m["height"])
		}
	}
	return out, heights, nil
}

// ownerAt 等拥有者 sid 的视图到达答复里的版本 version（视图在提交后更新），返回那时的状态。
func ownerAt(ctx context.Context, sid int32, key terrain.ChunkKey, version int64) (chunkProbe, error) {
	var got chunkProbe
	err := pollFast(ctx, 5*time.Second, fmt.Sprintf("sid %d's view of its chunk %v reaches version %d", sid, key, version), func() (bool, string) {
		var err error
		got, err = probeOne(ctx, sid, key)
		if err != nil {
			return false, err.Error()
		}
		return got.Owned && got.Loaded && got.Version == version, got.String()
	})
	return got, err
}

// probeOne 是一块在 sid 进程里的状态。
func probeOne(ctx context.Context, sid int32, key terrain.ChunkKey) (chunkProbe, error) {
	got, _, err := probe(ctx, sid, []terrain.ChunkKey{key})
	return got[key], err
}

// heightAt 是 sid 进程视图里一点的世界高度（厘米）。
func heightAt(ctx context.Context, sid int32, x, y int64) (int64, bool, error) {
	_, heights, err := probe(ctx, sid, nil, [2]int64{x, y})
	h, ok := heights[[2]int64{x, y}]
	return h, ok, err
}

// waitAligned 等 sid 进程视图里的 key 与 want（拥有者的版本与摘要）相同，返回从 since 起的耗时（5ms 轮询，上限 timeout）。
func waitAligned(ctx context.Context, sid int32, key terrain.ChunkKey, want chunkProbe, since time.Time, timeout time.Duration, what string) (time.Duration, error) {
	var took time.Duration
	err := pollFast(ctx, timeout, what, func() (bool, string) {
		got, err := probeOne(ctx, sid, key)
		if err != nil {
			return false, err.Error()
		}
		took = time.Since(since)
		return got.Loaded && got.Version == want.Version && got.Digest == want.Digest, fmt.Sprintf("sid %d chunk %v %v want v%d %s", sid, key, got, want.Version, want.Digest)
	})
	return took, err
}

// waitClientHolds 等客户端持有 key 的 want 版本与摘要，返回第一次收到这个版本的时刻距 since 的耗时。
func waitClientHolds(ctx context.Context, c *client, key terrain.ChunkKey, want chunkProbe, since time.Time, timeout time.Duration) (time.Duration, error) {
	err := pollFast(ctx, timeout, c.name+" holds chunk "+key.String(), func() (bool, string) {
		version, digest, ok := c.chunk(key)
		if err := c.err(); err != nil {
			return false, err.Error()
		}
		return ok && version == want.Version && digest == want.Digest, fmt.Sprintf("held %v v%d %s want v%d %s", ok, version, digest, want.Version, want.Digest)
	})
	if err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("%w; the client holds terrain %s; its process (sid %d) partition terrain %v", err, c.terrainSummary(), c.sid, replicaStats(ctx, c.sid))
	}
	at, _ := c.chunkSeenAt(key, want.Version)
	return max(at.Sub(since), 0), nil
}

// pollFast 是 waitFor 的 5ms 版本（测延迟用）。
func pollFast(ctx context.Context, timeout time.Duration, what string, cond func() (bool, string)) error {
	deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
	for {
		ok, detail := cond()
		if ok {
			return nil
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: not reached within %s (%s)", what, timeout, detail)
		}
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return ctx.Err()
		case <-time.After(5 * time.Millisecond):
		}
	}
}

// ---- 编辑 ----

type brush struct {
	op           int32 // 1 抬高、2 降低
	x, y, radius int64
	strength     int32
}

func raise(x, y, radius int64, strength int32) brush {
	return brush{op: 1, x: x, y: y, radius: radius, strength: strength}
}
func lower(b brush) brush { b.op = 2; return b }

// edit 发一次笔刷（常数衰减）。配额不够（terrain_rate）时退避后用同一序号重发。
func (c *client) edit(ctx context.Context, seq uint64, b brush) (*pb.TerrainEditResponse, error) {
	for attempt := 0; ; attempt++ {
		raw, err := c.call(ctx, msgid.MsgTerrainEdit, must(pb.MarshalTerrainEditRequest(&pb.TerrainEditRequest{
			Seq: seq, Op: b.op, X: b.x, Y: b.y, Radius: b.radius, Falloff: 0, Strength: b.strength,
		})))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		r, err := pb.UnmarshalTerrainEditResponse(raw)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if r.Code == codeTerrainRate && attempt < 20 {
			time.Sleep(300 * time.Millisecond)
			continue
		}
		return r, nil
	}
}

// mustEdit 是一次必须生效的编辑；返回答复里 key 的新版本。
func (c *client) mustEdit(ctx context.Context, seq uint64, b brush, key terrain.ChunkKey) (int64, error) {
	r, err := c.edit(ctx, seq, b)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if r.Code != 0 || r.Duplicate {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("%s edit seq %d %+v: code %d %s duplicate %v", c.name, seq, b, r.Code, r.Reason, r.Duplicate)
	}
	for _, chunk := range r.Chunks {
		if chunk.ChunkX == key.X && chunk.ChunkY == key.Y {
			return chunk.Version, nil
		}
	}
	return 0, fmt.Errorf("%s edit seq %d: chunk %v not in the answer %+v", c.name, seq, key, r.Chunks)
}

// lastSeq 是 Seq = 0 的查询：服务端已应用的最大序号。
func (c *client) lastSeq(ctx context.Context) (int64, error) {
	r, err := c.edit(ctx, 0, brush{})
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if r.Code != 0 {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("%s last seq: code %d %s", c.name, r.Code, r.Reason)
	}
	return r.LastSeq, nil
}

// ---- 分区状态 ----

// realIn 是 sid 这个格进程的区域表里 id 作为 Real 的状态（不在或不是 Real 时 ok 为 false）。
func realIn(ctx context.Context, sid int32, id int64) (map[string]any, bool, error) {
	entities, err := cellEntities(ctx, sid)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, false, err
	}
	for _, e := range entities {
		if asInt(e["id"]) == id && e["role"] == "real" {
			return e, true, nil
		}
	}
	return nil, false, nil
}

func ownerOf(ctx context.Context, baseSid int32, playerID int64) (int64, map[string]any, error) {
	state, err := gm(ctx, baseSid, "gm.scene.partition", map[string]any{"player_id": playerID})
	if err != nil {
		return 0, nil, err
	}
	return asInt(state["owner_sid"]), state, nil
}

func cellStat(ctx context.Context, sid int32, key string) int64 {
	stats, err := gm(ctx, sid, "gm.scene.partition", nil)
	if err != nil {
		return -1
	}
	return nodeStat(stats, key)
}

func replicaStats(ctx context.Context, sid int32) map[string]any {
	stats, err := gm(ctx, sid, "gm.scene.partition", nil)
	if err != nil {
		return map[string]any{"err": err.Error()}
	}
	t, _ := stats["terrain"].(map[string]any)
	return t
}

func ms(d time.Duration) float64 { return float64(d.Microseconds()) / 1000 }

// ---- 演练 ----

func runTerrain(ctx context.Context) error {
	accountsClient, stop, err := accounts()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer stop()
	nonce := strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().UnixNano()%1_000_000_000, 36)
	pA, err := login(ctx, accountsClient, "ta", 1001, nonce)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	pB, err := login(ctx, accountsClient, "tb", 1002, nonce)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	pB2, err := login(ctx, accountsClient, "tb2", 1002, nonce)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	pW, err := login(ctx, accountsClient, "tw", 1004, nonce)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, c := range []*client{pA, pB, pB2, pW} {
		c := c
		if err := waitFor(ctx, 10*time.Second, c.name+" sees itself", func() (bool, string) {
			s, ok := c.self()
			return ok && s.hp() > 0, fmt.Sprintf("self %d err %v", c.actorID, c.err())
		}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	// 0. 起点：各进程装着的块（游戏尺度的 ghost_band 70m 比一块宽：A、B 都装下整张 4 × 2 块的图；只做 Base 的 1000 / 1004
	//    不装），全部是原始块（Version 0）、摘要相同。
	views := map[int32]map[terrain.ChunkKey]chunkProbe{}
	for _, sid := range []int32{1000, 1001, 1002, 1004} {
		got, _, err := probe(ctx, sid, allChunks)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		views[sid] = got
	}
	base := views[1001][terrain.ChunkKey{}].Digest
	for _, key := range allChunks {
		for sid, wantLoaded := range map[int32]bool{1001: true, 1002: true, 1000: false, 1004: false} {
			got := views[sid][key]
			wantOwned := sid == 1001 && key.X <= 1 || sid == 1002 && key.X >= 2
			if got.Loaded != wantLoaded || got.Owned != wantOwned || got.Loaded && (got.Version != 0 || got.Digest != base) {
				return fmt.Errorf("start: sid %d chunk %v is %v, want loaded %v owned %v at version 0 %s (a fresh database is required)", sid, key, got, wantLoaded, wantOwned, base)
			}
		}
	}
	if h, ok, err := heightAt(ctx, 1001, 11800, tPlayerY); err != nil || !ok || h != 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("start: A's height at the spawn: %d %v %v, want 0 (flat pack)", h, ok, err)
	}
	step("terrain_start", map[string]any{"base_digest": base, "a_loaded": 8, "b_loaded": 8, "base_only_loaded": 0})

	seqA, seqB := uint64(0), uint64(0)
	nextA := func() uint64 { seqA++; return seqA }
	nextB := func() uint64 { seqB++; return seqB }

	// (a) 格 A 在边界块 (1,0)（B 的 Ghost 带里）编辑：B 的视图（Ghost 带）与 B 上、只做 Base 的 1004 上的客户端都看到；A 的
	//     块 (0,0) 同样在 B 的 Ghost 带里（70m 的带盖住了 A 的两列块），B 的视图与客户端都跟上。B 上的玩家在分界线上的一笔
	//     跨格笔刷（P5）：B 把它拆给 A（块 (1,0)）与自己（块 (2,0)），两块都执行；再用反向的笔刷改回平地（后面的步骤要
	//     块 (2,0) 是平地）。
	boundaryKey, farKey := terrain.ChunkKey{X: 1}, terrain.ChunkKey{}
	sent := time.Now()
	v, err := pA.mustEdit(ctx, nextA(), raise(12000, 1000, 200, 10), boundaryKey)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	answered := time.Now()
	ownerBoundary, err := ownerAt(ctx, 1001, boundaryKey, v)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	ghostTook, err := waitAligned(ctx, 1002, boundaryKey, ownerBoundary, answered, 5*time.Second, "B's ghost band takes A's boundary edit")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	farSent := time.Now()
	v, err = pA.mustEdit(ctx, nextA(), raise(3000, 1000, 200, 10), farKey)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	farAnswered := time.Now()
	ownerFar, err := ownerAt(ctx, 1001, farKey, v)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	clientTook := map[string]float64{}
	for _, c := range []*client{pB, pW, pA} {
		for key, want := range map[terrain.ChunkKey]chunkProbe{boundaryKey: ownerBoundary, farKey: ownerFar} {
			since := sent // 从发出编辑请求算起（客户端的到达时刻是读到那一帧时记下的）
			if key == farKey {
				since = farSent
			}
			took, err := waitClientHolds(ctx, c, key, want, since, 5*time.Second)
			if err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("(a) %w", err)
			}
			clientTook[c.name+"_"+key.String()] = ms(took)
		}
	}
	if _, err := waitAligned(ctx, 1002, farKey, ownerFar, farAnswered, 5*time.Second, "B's ghost band takes A's far edit"); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("(a) %w", err)
	}
	cross := raise(tBoundary, 1200, 200, 10)
	crossKeys := []terrain.ChunkKey{{X: 1}, {X: 2}}
	crossSent := time.Now()
	var crossRTT []float64
	for _, b := range []brush{cross, lower(cross)} {
		r, err := pB.edit(ctx, nextB(), b)
		if err != nil || r.Code != 0 || len(r.Chunks) != 2 {
			return fmt.Errorf("(a) B's cross-cell brush %+v: %v %+v, want both chunks done", b, err, r)
		}
		crossRTT = append(crossRTT, ms(time.Since(crossSent)))
		for i, chunk := range r.Chunks {
			if chunk.ChunkX != crossKeys[i].X || chunk.ChunkY != crossKeys[i].Y || chunk.Outcome != outcomeApplied {
				return fmt.Errorf("(a) B's cross-cell brush: chunk %d of the answer %+v, want %v applied", i, chunk, crossKeys[i])
			}
			owner := int32(1001)
			if crossKeys[i].X >= 2 {
				owner = 1002
			}
			if _, err := ownerAt(ctx, owner, crossKeys[i], chunk.Version); err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("(a) %w", err)
			}
		}
		crossSent = time.Now()
	}
	for i, key := range crossKeys {
		owner := int32(1001 + i)
		got, err := probeOne(ctx, owner, key)
		if err != nil || got.Digest != base && key.X == 2 {
			return fmt.Errorf("(a) chunk %v after the cross-cell brush and its reverse: %v %v, want the flat base", key, got, err)
		}
	}
	step("terrain_ghost_edit", map[string]any{"edit_rtt_ms": ms(answered.Sub(sent)), "far_edit_rtt_ms": ms(farAnswered.Sub(farSent)),
		"owner_version": ownerBoundary.Version, "b_ghost_after_answer_ms": ms(ghostTook), "clients_after_request_ms": clientTook,
		"b_view_far_chunk_loaded": true, "b_cross_cell_brush_rtt_ms": crossRTT})

	// (b1) 真实 SceneActor：B 紧挨分界线（x 13000～13600、y 3000 那一行）抬起 5 米的坎，推到 A 的 Ghost 带；pW（Base 是只做
	//      Base 的 1004，SceneActor 在格 A）朝东走：越过分界线、停在坎前最后一个整数点 12949（坎的第一个节点从 12950 起），
	//      没到交接线 13000，一直是 A 的 Real；坎挖平后接着走，交给 B。
	playerStep := raise(13300, tPlayerY, 300, tStepRaw)
	stepKey := terrain.ChunkKey{X: 2}
	v, err = pB.mustEdit(ctx, nextB(), playerStep, stepKey)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	stepAnswered := time.Now()
	ownerStep, err := ownerAt(ctx, 1002, stepKey, v)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	stepGhost, err := waitAligned(ctx, 1001, stepKey, ownerStep, stepAnswered, 5*time.Second, "A's ghost band takes B's step")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if h, ok, err := heightAt(ctx, 1001, 13000, tPlayerY); err != nil || !ok || h != tStepRaw*10 {
		return fmt.Errorf("(b) A's view at the step's first node: %d %v %v, want %d", h, ok, err, tStepRaw*10)
	}
	// pW 自己的 SceneActor 的完整 ID 取客户端从同步里认出的那个（本程序没有登记实体种类，不自己拼 ID）。
	pW.mu.Lock()
	actorW := pW.actorID
	pW.mu.Unlock()
	if _, isReal, err := realIn(ctx, 1001, actorW); err != nil || !isReal {
		return fmt.Errorf("(b) pW's scene actor is not a real on A: %v", err)
	}
	blocksBefore := cellStat(ctx, 1001, "SurfaceBlocks")
	walkStart := time.Now()
	if err := pW.moveIntent(ctx, tSpeed, 0); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var stopped map[string]any
	if err := waitFor(ctx, 15*time.Second, "pW stops at the step", func() (bool, string) {
		e, isReal, err := realIn(ctx, 1001, actorW)
		if err != nil {
			return false, err.Error()
		}
		if !isReal {
			b, onB, _ := realIn(ctx, 1002, actorW)
			return false, fmt.Sprintf("not a real on A (on B: %v %v)", onB, b)
		}
		stopped = e
		return asInt(e["vx"]) == 0 && asInt(e["x"]) > tBoundary, fmt.Sprintf("%v", e)
	}); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("(b) %w", err)
	}
	stopTook := time.Since(walkStart)
	stopX := asInt(stopped["x"])
	if stopX > 12949 || stopX <= tBoundary || asInt(stopped["y"]) != tPlayerY {
		return fmt.Errorf("(b) pW stopped at (%d, %d), want past the boundary %d and at most 12949 on y %d", stopX, asInt(stopped["y"]), tBoundary, tPlayerY)
	}
	// 停住之后 2 秒：仍是 A 的 Real、位置不变，Base 记的拥有者是 A，B 没有它的 Real，客户端看到的自己就在停下的位置。
	holdUntil := time.Now().Add(2 * time.Second)
	for time.Now().Before(holdUntil) {
		e, isReal, err := realIn(ctx, 1001, actorW)
		if err != nil || !isReal || asInt(e["x"]) != stopX {
			return fmt.Errorf("(b) pW after stopping: real on A %v at %v (%v), want held at %d", isReal, e, err, stopX)
		}
		if _, onB, _ := realIn(ctx, 1002, actorW); onB {
			return fmt.Errorf("(b) pW became a real on B while held at the step")
		}
		if owner, state, err := ownerOf(ctx, 1004, pW.playerID); err != nil || owner != 1001 {
			return fmt.Errorf("(b) the Base says pW is owned by %d (%v %v), want 1001", owner, state, err)
		}
		time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	selfW, _ := pW.self()
	if selfW.pos().X != stopX {
		return fmt.Errorf("(b) pW's client shows itself at %v, the cell holds it at %d", selfW.pos(), stopX)
	}
	blocks := cellStat(ctx, 1001, "SurfaceBlocks") - blocksBefore
	if blocks < 1 {
		return fmt.Errorf("(b) A's SurfaceBlocks did not move (%d)", blocks)
	}
	v, err = pB.mustEdit(ctx, nextB(), lower(playerStep), stepKey)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	levelAnswered := time.Now()
	ownerLevel, err := ownerAt(ctx, 1002, stepKey, v)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if ownerLevel.Digest != base {
		return fmt.Errorf("(b) the levelled chunk %v is not the flat base %s again", ownerLevel, base)
	}
	levelGhost, err := waitAligned(ctx, 1001, stepKey, ownerLevel, levelAnswered, 5*time.Second, "A's ghost band takes the levelled step")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	crossStart := time.Now()
	if err := pW.moveIntent(ctx, tSpeed, 0); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var crossed time.Duration
	if err := waitFor(ctx, 10*time.Second, "pW is handed to B", func() (bool, string) {
		owner, state, err := ownerOf(ctx, 1004, pW.playerID)
		crossed = time.Since(crossStart)
		return err == nil && owner == 1002, fmt.Sprintf("%v %v", state, err)
	}); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("(b) %w", err)
	}
	if err := pW.moveIntent(ctx, 0, 0); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	onB, isRealOnB, err := realIn(ctx, 1002, actorW)
	if err != nil || !isRealOnB || asInt(onB["x"]) < tHandoff {
		return fmt.Errorf("(b) pW after the handover: real on B %v %v (%v)", isRealOnB, onB, err)
	}
	step("terrain_player_step", map[string]any{"step_ghost_after_answer_ms": ms(stepGhost), "stop_x": stopX, "want_stop_x": 12949,
		"stop_after_intent_ms": stopTook.Milliseconds(), "held_ms": 2000, "a_surface_blocks": blocks,
		"level_ghost_after_answer_ms": ms(levelGhost), "handed_to_b_after_intent_ms": crossed.Milliseconds(), "x_on_b": asInt(onB["x"])})

	// (b2) 真实 Monster：格 A 里沿 y = 9000 往返的怪朝东经过 x 11300～12300 时，B 在分界线后抬起同样的坎（块 (2,1)，Ghost 带），
	//      A 在它身后 x 10400～11000 立一道墙（块 (1,1)，A 自己的）：怪越过分界线、在坎前折回（不交给 B），在墙前再折回，
	//      困在两者之间；坎挖平后怪交给 B。
	monster, err := findTerrainMonster(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	monsterKey, wallKey := terrain.ChunkKey{X: 2, Y: 1}, terrain.ChunkKey{X: 1, Y: 1}
	monsterStep := raise(13300, tMonsterY, 300, tStepRaw)
	wall := raise(10700, tMonsterY, 300, tStepRaw)
	var caughtAt map[string]any
	waitedFor := time.Now()
	if err := pollFast(ctx, 100*time.Second, "the monster walks east through x 11300..12300 on A", func() (bool, string) {
		e, isReal, err := realIn(ctx, 1001, monster)
		if err != nil {
			return false, err.Error()
		}
		caughtAt = e
		return isReal && asInt(e["vx"]) > 0 && asInt(e["x"]) >= 11300 && asInt(e["x"]) <= 12300, fmt.Sprintf("%v", e)
	}); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("(b) %w", err)
	}
	waited := time.Since(waitedFor)
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	var stepErr, wallErr error
	var stepVersion int64
	stepSeq, wallSeq := nextB(), nextA()
	wg.Add(2)
	go func() { defer wg.Done(); stepVersion, stepErr = pB.mustEdit(ctx, stepSeq, monsterStep, monsterKey) }()
	go func() { defer wg.Done(); _, wallErr = pA.mustEdit(ctx, wallSeq, wall, wallKey) }()
	wg.Wait()
	if err := errors.Join(stepErr, wallErr); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	ownerMStep, err := ownerAt(ctx, 1002, monsterKey, stepVersion)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := waitAligned(ctx, 1001, monsterKey, ownerMStep, time.Now(), 5*time.Second, "A's ghost band takes the monster's step"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	editedAt, _, _ := realIn(ctx, 1001, monster)
	turns, err := watchCorral(ctx, monster, 4, 30*time.Second)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("(b) %w (caught at %v, after the edits at %v)", err, caughtAt, editedAt)
	}
	v, err = pB.mustEdit(ctx, nextB(), lower(monsterStep), monsterKey)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	levelM, err := ownerAt(ctx, 1002, monsterKey, v)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := waitAligned(ctx, 1001, monsterKey, levelM, time.Now(), 5*time.Second, "A's ghost band takes the levelled monster step"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	levelledAt := time.Now()
	var handedAfter time.Duration
	if err := waitFor(ctx, 20*time.Second, "the monster is handed to B", func() (bool, string) {
		e, isReal, err := realIn(ctx, 1002, monster)
		handedAfter = time.Since(levelledAt)
		return err == nil && isReal, fmt.Sprintf("%v %v", e, err)
	}); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("(b) %w", err)
	}
	step("terrain_monster_step", map[string]any{"monster": monster, "waited_for_the_monster_ms": waited.Milliseconds(),
		"caught_at": caughtAt, "after_the_edits": editedAt, "turns": turns, "handed_to_b_after_levelling_ms": handedAfter.Milliseconds()})

	// (c) 格进程崩溃重启：B 提交一次边界编辑（块 (2,0)，在 A 的 Ghost 带里）、答复到了就读一次 B 的视图，然后 pB2 在 B 的
	//     块 (3,1) 上连续编辑，期间 kill -9 B；B 停机时 A 改它的边界块 (1,1)（B 的 Ghost 带）。B 重启之后：块 (2,0) 仍是崩溃
	//     前读到的版本与数据（WAL 持久），A 的 Ghost 带与它对齐；B 的 Ghost 带补上 A 停机期间的编辑；pB2 的账本 LastSeq 不小于
	//     最后一次答复成功的序号，且块 (3,1) 的版本等于 LastSeq（块与账本同一笔事务）；用同一序号重发答 Duplicate。
	if *killCmd == "" || *restartCmd == "" {
		return errors.New("(c) -kill and -restart are required")
	}
	crashKey, burstKey := terrain.ChunkKey{X: 2}, terrain.ChunkKey{X: 3, Y: 1}
	v, err = pB.mustEdit(ctx, nextB(), raise(14000, 1000, 200, 10), crashKey)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	committed, err := ownerAt(ctx, 1002, crashKey, v)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	type ack struct {
		seq uint64
		at  time.Time
	}
	var (
		burstMu  sync.Mutex
		acks     []ack
		burstErr error
	)
	burstDone := make(chan struct{})
	go func() {
		defer close(burstDone)
		for seq := uint64(1); ; seq++ {
			r, err := pB2.edit(ctx, seq, raise(22000+int64(seq%20)*100, tMonsterY, 100, 1))
			burstMu.Lock()
			if err != nil || r.Code != 0 {
				burstErr = fmt.Errorf("seq %d: %v %+v", seq, err, r)
				burstMu.Unlock()
				return
			}
			acks = append(acks, ack{seq, time.Now()})
			burstMu.Unlock()
			time.Sleep(50 * time.Millisecond)
		}
	}()
	if err := waitFor(ctx, 10*time.Second, "pB2's burst got 5 answers", func() (bool, string) {
		burstMu.Lock()
		defer burstMu.Unlock()
		return len(acks) >= 5, fmt.Sprintf("%d acks, %v", len(acks), burstErr)
	}); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("(c) %w", err)
	}
	aHeldBeforeKill, _ := probeOne(ctx, 1001, crashKey)
	killedAt := time.Now()
	if err := shell(*killCmd); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("(c) kill: %w", err)
	}
	<-burstDone
	burstMu.Lock()
	lastAck := acks[len(acks)-1]
	ackCount, burstEnd := len(acks), burstErr
	burstMu.Unlock()
	pB.raw.Close()
	pB2.raw.Close()
	downKey := terrain.ChunkKey{X: 1, Y: 1}
	v, err = pA.mustEdit(ctx, nextA(), raise(12000, 7000, 200, 10), downKey)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	ownerDown, err := ownerAt(ctx, 1001, downKey, v)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := shell(*restartCmd); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("(c) restart: %w", err)
	}
	readyAt := time.Now()
	afterRestart, err := probeOne(ctx, 1002, crashKey)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if afterRestart.Version != committed.Version || afterRestart.Digest != committed.Digest {
		return fmt.Errorf("(c) B's chunk %v after the restart is %v, before the kill (answered) %v", crashKey, afterRestart, committed)
	}
	aAligned, err := waitAligned(ctx, 1001, crashKey, committed, readyAt, 10*time.Second, "A's ghost band matches B after the restart")
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("(c) %w", err)
	}
	bCaughtUp, err := waitAligned(ctx, 1002, downKey, ownerDown, readyAt, 10*time.Second, "B's ghost band catches up with A's edit made while B was down")
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("(c) %w", err)
	}
	burstOwner, err := probeOne(ctx, 1002, burstKey)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	pB2again, err := login(ctx, accountsClient, "tb2", 1002, nonce)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer pB2again.raw.Close()
	last, err := pB2again.lastSeq(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if last < int64(lastAck.seq) || burstOwner.Version != last {
		return fmt.Errorf("(c) after the restart pB2's ledger says %d, the burst chunk is at %v; the last answered seq was %d", last, burstOwner, lastAck.seq)
	}
	again, err := pB2again.edit(ctx, lastAck.seq, raise(22000+int64(lastAck.seq%20)*100, tMonsterY, 100, 1))
	if err != nil || again.Code != 0 || !again.Duplicate {
		return fmt.Errorf("(c) resending the last answered seq %d: %v %+v, want duplicate", lastAck.seq, err, again)
	}
	if got, _ := probeOne(ctx, 1002, burstKey); got.Version != burstOwner.Version || got.Digest != burstOwner.Digest {
		return fmt.Errorf("(c) the duplicate changed the chunk: %v -> %v", burstOwner, got)
	}
	pBagain, err := login(ctx, accountsClient, "tb", 1002, nonce)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer pBagain.raw.Close()
	clientsAfter := map[string]float64{}
	for _, c := range []*client{pBagain, pW, pA} {
		for key, want := range map[terrain.ChunkKey]chunkProbe{crashKey: committed, downKey: ownerDown, burstKey: burstOwner} {
			took, err := waitClientHolds(ctx, c, key, want, readyAt, 15*time.Second)
			if err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("(c) %w", err)
			}
			clientsAfter[c.name+"_"+key.String()] = ms(took)
		}
	}
	var reenter time.Duration
	reenterErr := waitFor(ctx, 20*time.Second, "pW re-entered on B", func() (bool, string) {
		owner, state, err := ownerOf(ctx, 1004, pW.playerID)
		reenter = time.Since(readyAt)
		return err == nil && owner == 1002 && asInt(state["epoch"]) > 0, fmt.Sprintf("%v %v", state, err)
	})
	detail := map[string]any{"committed_before_kill": committed.String(), "a_held_before_kill": aHeldBeforeKill.String(),
		"down_seconds": readyAt.Sub(killedAt).Seconds(), "b_after_restart": afterRestart.String(),
		"a_ghost_aligned_after_ready_ms": ms(aAligned), "b_ghost_caught_up_after_ready_ms": ms(bCaughtUp),
		"burst_answers": ackCount, "burst_last_answered_seq": lastAck.seq, "burst_end": fmt.Sprint(burstEnd),
		"burst_answer_to_kill_ms": killedAt.Sub(lastAck.at).Milliseconds(), "ledger_last_seq_after_restart": last,
		"burst_chunk_after_restart": burstOwner.String(), "resend_last_answered": "duplicate", "clients_after_ready_ms": clientsAfter}
	if reenterErr == nil {
		detail["pw_reentered_on_b_after_ready_ms"] = reenter.Milliseconds()
	} else {
		detail["pw_reentered_on_b"] = reenterErr.Error()
	}
	step("terrain_cell_restart", detail)

	// 收尾核对：每一块在每个装着它的进程里与拥有者的版本、摘要相同；三个客户端持有的改过的块也一样。
	final := map[int32]map[terrain.ChunkKey]chunkProbe{}
	for _, sid := range []int32{1001, 1002} {
		got, _, err := probe(ctx, sid, allChunks)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		final[sid] = got
	}
	table := map[string]string{}
	for _, key := range allChunks {
		ownerSid := int32(1001)
		if key.X >= 2 {
			ownerSid = 1002
		}
		owner := final[ownerSid][key]
		table[key.String()] = owner.String()
		for sid, view := range final {
			if got := view[key]; got.Loaded && (got.Version != owner.Version || got.Digest != owner.Digest) {
				return fmt.Errorf("final: chunk %v on sid %d is %v, the owner %d has %v", key, sid, got, ownerSid, owner)
			}
		}
		if owner.Version == 0 {
			continue
		}
		for _, c := range []*client{pBagain, pW, pA} {
			if _, err := waitClientHolds(ctx, c, key, owner, time.Now(), 5*time.Second); err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("final: %w", err)
			}
		}
	}
	step("terrain_consistent", map[string]any{"chunks": table, "replicas_a": replicaStats(ctx, 1001), "replicas_b": replicaStats(ctx, 1002),
		"replicas_1004": replicaStats(ctx, 1004)})
	return nil
}

// findTerrainMonster 找到演练里唯一的那只怪（在 A 或 B 的区域表里是 Real）。
func findTerrainMonster(ctx context.Context) (int64, error) {
	var found []int64
	for _, sid := range []int32{1001, 1002} {
		entities, err := cellEntities(ctx, sid)
		if err != nil {
			return 0, err
		}
		for _, e := range entities {
			if e["role"] == "real" && entity.GetEntityKindFromID(asInt(e["id"])) == kindMonster {
				found = append(found, asInt(e["id"]))
			}
		}
	}
	if len(found) != 1 {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("want exactly one monster in the terrain drill, found %v", found)
	}
	return found[0], nil
}

// watchCorral 盯着被坎与墙困住的怪，直到看到 turns 次折回：每次在坎前折回时它越过了分界线、没到 12949 之后，在墙前折回时
// 不在 11050 之前；期间它一直是 A 的 Real、B 没有它。返回每次折回前看到的最远点。
func watchCorral(ctx context.Context, monster int64, turns int, timeout time.Duration) ([]string, error) {
	deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
	var out []string
	var lastVX, far int64 // far：当前方向上看到的最远点
	east := 0
	for len(out) < turns {
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			return out, fmt.Errorf("the monster turned %d times within %s (%v), want %d", len(out), timeout, out, turns)
		}
		e, isReal, err := realIn(ctx, 1001, monster)
		if err != nil {
			return out, err
		}
		if !isReal {
			b, onB, _ := realIn(ctx, 1002, monster)
			return out, fmt.Errorf("the monster left A while corralled (turns %v; real on B %v: %v)", out, onB, b)
		}
		x, vx := asInt(e["x"]), asInt(e["vx"])
		if asInt(e["y"]) != tMonsterY {
			return out, fmt.Errorf("the monster left its line: %v", e)
		}
		switch {
		case lastVX == 0:
			far = x
		case lastVX > 0 && vx < 0: // 在坎前折回
			if far <= tBoundary || far > 12949 {
				return out, fmt.Errorf("the monster turned back at x %d, want past the boundary %d and at most 12949", far, tBoundary)
			}
			out = append(out, fmt.Sprintf("east %d", far))
			east++
			far = x
		case lastVX < 0 && vx > 0: // 在墙前折回
			if far < 11050 {
				return out, fmt.Errorf("the monster turned back at x %d, want not before the wall (11050)", far)
			}
			out = append(out, fmt.Sprintf("west %d", far))
			far = x
		case vx > 0:
			far = max(far, x)
		case vx < 0:
			far = min(far, x)
		}
		if vx != 0 {
			lastVX = vx
		}
		time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	if east == 0 {
		return out, errors.New("the monster never turned back at the step")
	}
	return out, nil
}
